info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Guarantee Status API
info.description: The Bank Guarantee Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of a bank guarantee. This API provides detailed insights into the status of bank guarantees, aiding financial institutions in managing trade-related obligations efficiently. Typical consumers include bankers, trade finance professionals, and enterprises involved in international transactions. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure that they have up-to-date information vital for decision-making and risk assessment.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific bank guarantee details.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific bank guarantee identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure to have the correct resource ID to get accurate results.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to bank guarantee operation RES-100045. It includes necessary parameters to specify the request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of bank guarantee details.

GetBankGuaranteeByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to bank guarantee in the trade banking system.

corporateCustomerId.description: The unique identifier for the corporate customer.

facilityId.description: The unique identifier for the facility associated with the bank guarantee.

counterpartyId.description: The unique identifier for the counterparty in the transaction.

amount.description: The amount associated with the bank guarantee, specifying value and currency.

maturityDate.description: The date when the bank guarantee matures.

guaranteeType.description: The type of guarantee being provided.

beneficiaryId.description: The unique identifier for the beneficiary of the bank guarantee.

claimExpiryDate.description: The date when a claim against the guarantee will expire.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the bank guarantee record.

version.description: The version number of the bank guarantee record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the bank guarantee information was last updated.

GetBankGuaranteeByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving bank guarantee operations.

value.description: The numerical value of the bank guarantee amount.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

Amount.description: Object representing the amount details including currency.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracking requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the bank guarantee took place.

Metadata.description: Additional metadata about the response including identifiers and timestamps.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. A valid JWT (JSON Web Token) must be included in the request to access secured resources.
